results.title: A comprehensive survey of loss functions and metrics in deep ...
results.content: A comprehensive survey of loss functions and metrics in deep learning | Artificial Intelligence Review | Springer Nature Link This paper presents a comprehensive review of loss functions and performance metrics in deep learning, highlighting key developments and practical insights across diverse application areas. One of the critical components of deep learning is the selection of the loss function and performance metrics used for training and evaluating models. Choosing the appropriate loss function and performance metric is essential for success in deep learning tasks. Loss functions and performance metrics are two distinct tools for evaluating the performance of a deep learning model and serve different purposes. During the training of a deep learning model, loss functions are used to optimize the model’s parameters, whereas performance metrics are used to evaluate the model’s performance after training. The ultimate goal of training a deep learning model is to minimize the loss function, while evaluating a model aims to maximize the performance metric, with the exception of error performance metrics such as Mean Squared Error.
